text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt or turf? Copano Rickey decided to go 
around asking other Umamusume why they 
chose their respective courses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae chose the dirt tracks out of 
love for her hometown. She saw her home's 
rise reflected in her own ambition to 
surge forward from the modest dirt scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, her distinguished dirt 
senior, Smart Falcon, shared that she 
chose dirt races for the sake of her own 
dream as an Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey believed dirt tracks—where 
Qi was easier to read—were best suited for 
fulfilling her dream of spreading Feng 
Shui, yet... something still bothered her.
